title: Dala Property Management
description: Properties, units, leases, sales, commissions and maintenance
content:
# Dala Property Management

Dala by Base manages real-estate portfolios for both **sales** (developments, plots) and **rentals** (leases).

## The Dala menu
| Page | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Dashboard** | Revenue, rent collection, commissions, leases and maintenance |
| **Portfolio** (Properties) | Properties, blocks, floors and units |
| **Property Types** | Types such as apartment, plot, commercial |
| **Sales** | Unit/plot sales with payment plans |
| **Leases & Rentals** | Lease agreements and rent |
| **Commissions** | Agent commissions and payments |
| **Rent Collection** | Rent invoices and payments |
| **Maintenance** | Maintenance tickets and costs |
| **Reports** | Sales, rent, commission and maintenance reports |

## The Dala dashboard
Choose the period (Day, Week, Month, Year, Custom) to see **Portfolio Scale**, **Total Revenue**, **Rental Collections**, the **Commissions Pipeline**, a **Revenue Trend**, **Top Agents**, **Active Leases**, **Occupancy Rate**, **Deposits Held**, rent due and open maintenance tickets.

## Getting started
1. Enable Dala in **Discover**.
2. Add **Property Types**.
3. Create **Properties** with their blocks, floors and units.
4. Add **customers/clients** (called **Clients** in Dala).
5. Create **leases** or **sales**.
6. Track **rent**, **commissions** and **maintenance**.

title: Lease & Rent Management
description: Create leases, set terms and deposits, and generate rent invoices
content:
# Lease & Rent Management

Open **Leases & Rentals** to manage tenants and rent. Cards show **Total Leases/Rentals**, total amount and those **Expiring Soon**. Filter by status, type, property and date, or search.

## Create a lease
Click **New Lease/Rental**. The form has three steps:

### 1. Lease details
Property, unit, **occupant (tenant)**, **lease type** (Monthly, Short Stay, Annual, Lease to Own, Commercial), start and end dates, unit area, currency and lease amount (or amount per sqm).

### 2. Payment terms
**Payment frequency** (Monthly, Quarterly, Semi-Annually, Annually), **payment due day**, **deposit** (amount, paid, paid date, refunded and deductions), **service charge** and its frequency, and **utilities the tenant pays** (electricity, internet, garbage and so on).

### 3. Terms & submit
Status (Active, Notice, Expired, Terminated, Vacated), signed date, notice and vacate dates, **termination reason**, **escalations** and **documents**.

## Rent escalations
Add a **lease escalation** with an effective date and either a **fixed amount** or a **percentage**. The new rent and when it was applied are recorded.

## Deposits and charges
Use **Update Deposit** to record payment, refund and deductions, and **Update Service Charge** to change it.

## Generate rent invoices
Click **Generate Invoices** (or **Generate Bulk Invoices**). Choose the **period start and end** and the **due date** to invoice all active leases at once.

## Collect rent
In **Rent Collection** see **Total Billed**, **Collected**, **Outstanding** and **Paid Invoices**, and record payments by method. Payments flow to accounting if Pesa is enabled.

## Tips
- Keep tenant documents on the lease (ID, agreement).
- Review **Expiring Soon** monthly to start renewals early.

title: Maintenance Management
description: Raise tickets, assign work, add updates and record costs
content:
# Maintenance Management

Open **Maintenance** for property tickets and general support tickets.

## Dashboard cards
**Total Tickets**, **Open Tickets**, **In Progress**, **Urgent Tickets**, **Estimated Cost** and **Actual Cost**.

## Create a ticket
Click **New Ticket**:
- **Ticket Type**: Property maintenance or General.
- **Property**, **Unit/Apartment**, **Lease** and **Occupant** (a property is required for maintenance tickets).
- **Title**, **Category** (for example Plumbing, Electrical, Painting) and **Priority**.
- **Requester** name, phone and email.
- **Assigned to**, **due date** and **scheduled date**.

## Work the ticket
Open a ticket to see the **Overview**, **Updates** and **Costs**.
- **Change Status**: Open, In Progress, Resolved.
- **Add Update**: write a message and choose **Public** (visible to the requester) or **Internal**; optionally change status at the same time.
- **Add Cost**: vendor, amount, currency, paid status and date, and a **receipt URL**. Costs add up as **Actual Cost**.

## Categories
Use the **Categories** tab to create and colour categories, set the sort order, mark a default, and activate or deactivate them.

## Reports
Run the **Maintenance** report in Dala Reports by date, category and status to see tickets with estimated and actual cost.

## Tips
- Set priorities honestly; urgent should mean urgent.
- Add a public update when work starts and finishes so tenants feel looked after.

title: Property Analytics & Reports
description: Portfolio, sales, rent collection, commissions and maintenance reports
content:
# Property Analytics & Reports

## Dashboard
The **Dala dashboard** summarises your portfolio for the period you pick: total revenue, rental collections, commissions pipeline, revenue trend, **top agents**, occupancy and open maintenance tickets.

## Reports
Open **Reports** in Dala (or the Dala tab in the main Reports page). Choose a **date and time range** and run:

| Report | Shows |
|---|---|
| **Portfolio** | Total properties, units sold, available units, portfolio value, sales progress by property and unit status distribution |
| **Sales** | Sale code, customer, sale date, price, agent; totals paid and balance |
| **Payment Plans Due** | Installments due, paid amount and balance |
| **Commissions Due** | Commission amount, withholding tax, paid and balance by agent |
| **Already Paid Payments** | Payments received with method and reference |
| **Rent Collection** | Tenant, invoice, amount, paid date and outstanding |
| **Maintenance** | Tickets by category, priority and status with costs |

## Filters
Property, agent/user, status and date range depending on the report.

## Export
**Export Excel** or **Export PDF**.

## Tips
- Review **Payment Plans Due** weekly to chase instalments.
- Use **Commissions Due** before paying agents so you only pay what clients have paid.

title: Properties, Blocks & Units
description: Set up a property with its blocks, apartments, plots and pricing phases
content:
# Properties, Blocks & Units

## Property types
Open **Property Types** and click **Add Property Type**. Enter a **name**, **slug** and description, and set the status to Active or Inactive.

## Create a property
Click **New Property**. The form follows two steps:
1. **Basic Information**: property name, **type**, **purpose** (sale, rental or mixed), location and manager.
2. **Units & Pricing**: phases, blocks and units.

Save a draft and come back later; use **Clear Draft** to start over.

## Blocks and floors (apartments)
Use **Block Management** to add blocks (**Block name** and **Total floors**, up to 20 floors per block). Then **Add Apartment Unit**: choose the block, floor, unit number, **unit type** (Studio, One/Two/Three Bedroom, Penthouse, Shop or Other), area in sqm, and the rent term and deposit.

Tick **Track Individual Apartments** to name each unit (sequential like BA111-1, letters like BA111-A, or custom names).

## Plots (land)
Use **Add Land Plot**: plot size and number of plots.

## Pricing phases
Add **Pricing Phases** with start and end dates, then set the **unit price for each phase**. Drag rows to reorder phases, and delete a phase to remove its pricing.

## Units
Open **Units** to create or edit a unit directly: property, block, floor, **unit name and code**, type (Residential, Commercial, Industrial), **status** (Available, Reserved, Rented, Maintenance, Occupied, Under Construction), area, bedrooms and bathrooms.
- **Sale units:** base price, price per sqm, min and max price, currency.
- **Rental units:** monthly rent, rent per sqm and service charge.

## Status meanings
**Available** can be sold or let. **Reserved** has a booking. **Rented/Occupied** has a tenant or owner. **Maintenance** and **Under Construction** are unavailable.

title: Property Sales, Payment Plans & Commissions
description: Sell units or plots, schedule instalments and pay agents
content:
# Property Sales, Payment Plans & Commissions

## Record a sale
Open **Sales** and click **Create**. The form has three steps:

### 1. Sale details
Choose the **property**, **unit** (or individual **apartment**, where the price fills in automatically), the **client**, **list price**, **sale price** and **sale date**. Tick **Joint Purchase** to add 2 to 10 customers.

### 2. Payment details
- **Initial payment type**: a non-refundable **Booking Fee** or a custom **Down Payment**.
- **Payment plan**: **Full Payment**, **Installment** or **Mortgage**.
- For installments choose the **frequency** (weekly to annually) and number, then **Generate Payment Plan** or add installments manually.
- Choose the payment method and date.

### 3. Terms & submit
Attach supporting documents, choose the **sales agent** and **property manager**, set the **commission rate**, and use **Split Commission** to divide it between several users. Choose the status: Reservation, Agreement, Processing, Completed or Cancelled.

## Record payments
Open a sale and **Add Payment** as the client pays. Progress shows against the payment plan.

## Commissions
Open **Commissions**. Cards show **Total Sales**, **Total Sales Value**, **Amount Paid by Clients**, **Accrued Commission**, **Total Commission**, **Paid Commission** and **Pending Commission**.

Commission is earned **based on what clients have actually paid**, so an agent's accrued commission grows as the client pays.

### Pay a commission
1. Select the agents and open the sale.
2. Click **Add Payment**.
3. Choose who to pay, the **gross amount** (it cannot exceed **Available to Pay**), the date and the method.
4. Optionally **apply withholding tax**; the net amount is shown.
5. Add the reference number, notes and **payment documents** (receipt, proof, M-Pesa confirmation, withholding tax certificate and so on).

Export to PDF from the commission screen.
